The shared `conversation.approval.card` Factory presents reject, allow and an optional always-allow action, with caller-owned scope, subject metadata and answer callbacks. Tool approvals retain their two outcomes. Application consent can re...

attrs.text: The shared `conversation.approval.card` Factory presents reject, allow and an optional always-allow action, with caller-owned scope, subject metadata and answer callbacks. Tool approvals retain their two outcomes. Application consent can reuse the card without adopting tool-approval policy. Subject metadata enables left-aligned content and wrapping actions; callers that omit it retain inherited alignment and a single action row. Icons and labels identify the subject visually; the caller owns identity verification and saved grants.

title: **Manual continuation uses a fixed product allowlist** — the supported failure codes are independent of the provider's configurable `retryableCodes`; changing automatic retry policy does not expand or reduce this action. `STREAM_CLOSED` per...

attrs.text: **Manual continuation uses a fixed product allowlist** — the supported failure codes are independent of the provider's configurable `retryableCodes`; changing automatic retry policy does not expand or reduce this action. `STREAM_CLOSED` permits an explicit new user turn even when the default policy does not retry it. That code can also identify a protocol violation, so another request is not guaranteed to recover.

attrs.text: **A failing Definition costs a full replay per publication** — after an incremental flush fails, the assembler replays the complete loaded window to keep the views correct. A Definition that fails on every update therefore replays the whole window on each publication until its owner fixes it ([window update paths](../../../docs/subsystems/conversation.md#window-update-paths)).
